      How ordering works

      1. Ask for an account

        Tell us about your store. We link your login to your existing Jovi customer account.

      2. Browse by brand and season

        Once you log in, you see your own price list in Canadian or US dollars.

      3. Order or build a list with your rep

        Add cases to your cart, or save a wishlist your rep can turn into an order or an Excel line sheet.

      About Jovi Sports

      JOVI SPORTS operates as fast-growing designer, importer, and wholesaler of outdoor winter accessories, activewear, swimwear, and other clothing for men, women and kids.

      Based in Montreal, Canada and with sourcing offices overseas, we leverage technology, data and unique supplier relationships to offer customers value-driven retail solutions for the 21st century.
